portrait.notes: All rects are 1x CSS px [x,y,w,h] on a 390x844 artboard. map_inner is the grid well (and the Meadow overview's 0-1 space). The portrait grid is 3 columns of 102 px tiles; each cell also reserves a 28 px star row (4 px gap + 24 px art) under the tile, with an 8 px row gap. A 3×3 of 9 tiles is 426 px tall including pad and fits the 496 px well without scrolling. Title, counters, Play, Timed and level-number chips are runtime text. Play is the main, largest button; the Timed toggle sits beside it (tap 120×56). Hide Timed on the Meadow overview. Chrome/tile/overlay outlines are ~half the previous weight (see README); 9-slice insets are unchanged because they follow corner radius, not stroke.

landscape.notes: Tabs sit in the header so the map + selected panel can share the remaining height. map_inner is the grid well. Short landscape (this 844×390 artboard, height ≤ 500) uses 5 columns of 96 px tiles; each cell reserves a 28 px star row under the tile. A 5+4 of 9 tiles is 272 px tall including pad and fits the 282 px well without scrolling. Taller landscape uses 4 columns of 112 px (see grid.json) and will scroll. Timed sits on the name/stars row (tap 116×56); Play stays the largest control at the bottom of the panel. Hide Timed when the selection is the Hub pin or an act region.
